notes: Not checked or still weak: (1) Loco: no street address anywhere (loco.com privacy page 404); its office is a locality-level point at PIN 560071 from aggregators, and the 'Pocket Aces' alias is wrong (separate company) but aliases are not settable here. (2) Marks & Spencer: no current company source; the Bengaluru office rests on a 2025 OSM POI plus an old trade report, so it is kept low and not confirmed as current. (3) Livspace: no company page gives an address; the Aurbis head office rests on four agreeing aggregators (medium). (4) Narayana Health's new Electronics City corporate office: Plot 84 West Avenue-1 could not be geocoded, so it is pinned to the Electronics City Phase 1 centroid, and the move is known only through Investywise's summary of a BSE filing, not the filing itself. (5) Kwalee: Tower C is not in OSM, so the pin is the Global Technology Park centroid. (6) Moody's Quay Building is not in OSM, so the pin is the Bagmane Tech Park centroid. (7) Mahindra: the Velankani EVTEC office comes from 2022 trade press and the Bommasandra plant plot is unresolved; neither was re-confirmed for 2025-26. (8) Marlabs' HQ city: its contact page lists New York (115 Broadway) first without calling it HQ; hqCity Piscataway is left unchanged. (9) Mastek's SEBI PDF was not re-fetched; it was judged on the pin matching the OSM building.
